en: The image shows a color reproduction of an old Christian wall fresco in an Eastern Orthodox style. The upper part depicts Christ (or God the Father) in a circular mandorla, blessing with one hand and holding a book with the other, surrounded by angels and decorative motifs. Below is the Virgin Mary with raised hands in the traditional Orans pose, with the Christ Child depicted on her chest, also in a circular medallion. The fresco is worn and partially damaged, with flaking plaster and faded pigments.
